steps: Push index.html to a GitHub repo (main branch, root folder)
Settings → Pages → Source: Deploy from branch → main → / (root) → Save
Wait ~60 seconds → your site is live at https://<username>.github.io/<repo>
github_pages._note: GitHub Pages serves static files — Supabase handles all the data

step_1_supabase: Copy Project URL and anon key from Settings → API
Paste into monthsary.html: SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_ANON
Run supabase_schema.sql in Supabase SQL Editor (Dashboard → SQL Editor → paste → Run)
Create Storage bucket: Dashboard → Storage → New bucket → name: gallery → Public: ON → Create
The SQL file already creates the storage policies automatically
step_2_deploy: Go to vercel.com → Import Git Repository → select repo → Deploy
OR use GitHub Pages (see github_pages steps above)
step_3_verify: Open site → enter PIN 6726 → go through loading and door
Open Gallery tab → click curtain to reveal frames
Hover any frame → tap 📷 button → select a photo
Check sync-status pill turns green (☁ Synced)
Open the site on another device → photo should appear automatically

how_cross_device_sync_works.upload: Photo → Supabase Storage bucket 'gallery' → permanent public URL → gallery_photos table
how_cross_device_sync_works.load: On every page open: fetch all rows from gallery_photos → display photos
how_cross_device_sync_works.realtime: Supabase Realtime channel watches gallery_photos → pushes INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE to all open browsers instantly
how_cross_device_sync_works.cache: localStorage stores URLs as a cache so photos show instantly before Supabase responds
how_cross_device_sync_works.fallback: If SUPABASE_URL/ANON are empty → photos stored as base64 in localStorage (single device only)
